root_causes: Static service minima were applied as latent-action corrections, creating a flat infeasible region and excessive correction dependency.
At the final episode step, terminal state-of-charge recovery could consume grid headroom before discretionary shore-power allocation was reduced.
Validation selection considered guardrail rate before value but did not rank all absolute service and correction gates as one fail-closed constraint set.
corrective_actions: Encode gate, intermodal, reefer, maintenance and terminal-chain minima directly into the smooth action mapping.
Retain state-dependent navigation closure and pilotage/towage corrections in the auditable latent-action ledger.
Reserve terminal state-of-charge grid headroom by reducing discretionary shore-power allocation before the inherited hard projection.
Treat one-part-per-million demand-cap float noise as numerical tolerance, not an operational violation.
Select only candidates that first pass every validation service, safety, projection and correction gate.
artifact_policy: Models and metrics are retained as rejected evidence and cannot be promoted or served as the V6 offline champion.
